newsitem.title: USA: Chelsea Clinton may want medical career, Hillary says.
newsitem.headline: Chelsea Clinton may want medical career, Hillary says.

text.p: Hillary Rodham Clinton said on Tuesday that her daughter Chelsea wanted to pursue a medical career but refused to reveal which college she had chosen to attend.

"Right now she's very interested in medicine. That's something she'll see if she likes when she goes to college. She'd like to be a doctor," the first lady said in an interview on the CNN programme "Larry King Live."
Hillary Clinton and President Bill Clinton are both lawyers and met at Yale when they were students. Bill Clinton also attended Georgetown University.

"Both Bill and I talked with her about our college experiences ... At one point she might have considered both of our particular colleges, but I think she wanted to branch out and be her own person," Hillary Clinton said.

The 17-year-old Chelsea, and her parents, have to decide on her academic future by Thursday because most top schools require an enrollment commitment by May 1. She has been considering Harvard, Princeton, Stanford and Yale.
But Mrs. Clinton refused to reveal which school Chelsea had decided on, saying only that it was "absolutely" her daughter's choice.
"Tomorrow we will make an announcement. It's the last day. I can tell you she will be going to college next year," she said.
